facts: A yearling barn is designated specifically for housing growing yearling dairy animals.
A heifer barn is designated for housing growing heifers before they enter the milking herd.
A sick barn or isolation pen is utilized to separate, monitor, and treat ill or injured dairy cattle.
The working area provides facilities (such as chutes, crushes, and headgates) for handling, restraint, medical treatment, and management procedures on cattle.
Page 39 is part of the 'Dairysquare - Dairy Farming Module'.
